name: Nordkalottruta
description_md:
Nordkalottruta is an international waymarked hiking route in Norway covering a distance of 402.9 km. The line matches the official route published by turrutebasen.

The route has 8513 m of ascent and 9574 m of descent. It is classified as hard, which is derived from distance and ascent. The walking time takes about 124 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
